ns2:section.sectionText: This course will examine a wide range of sedimentary structures formed in modern depositional environments, and seek to provide a state-of-the art review of these in terms of their controlling physical processes and sedimentary products. The course will be based around lectures, including some from guest speakers, student presentations of academic journal papers and writing/presentation of a research paper based on an individual literature-based project. As well as detailing a wide range of sedimentary structures, the course will also cover methods for their investigation in modern and ancient sedimentary environments. Standard letter graded. The class will meet in room 4047 NHB.
